CUNet_CB_TA__vs__R3.note: ours: MERT + belief propagation vs CPJKU CUNet

micro_vs_macro.macro_page_definition: unweighted mean over the 25 pages of each page ratio
micro_vs_macro.macro_piece_definition: unweighted mean over the 16 pieces of each piece ratio
micro_vs_macro.coda_baselines_are_micro: CODA copies CYOLO/cyolo_sb/cyolo_sb_a/CUNet numbers from Henkel & Widmer without re-running them
micro_vs_macro.inference_caveat: CODA ships no Setting II (real-audio) evaluation code; that its real-audio number used the macro aggregator is INFERRED from evaluate_batch.py being the only aggregator in the repo
micro_vs_macro.verdict: On an unchanged model the aggregation choice alone is worth up to +7.5 points -- larger than CODA's entire +1.8 margin over cyolo_sb_a and comparable to its +8.4 over cyolo_sb.

leaderboard_on_common_aggregator.reading: CODA 88.3 is bracketed by cyolo_sb_a own macro range 87.2 (page) to 89.17 (piece).  Matching the aggregator removes most or all of the claimed +1.8 lead over the prior SOTA; against the piece-macro it is negative.  Subject to the inference caveat above, and in any case far inside the +/-20 point unpaired MDD this benchmark supports.

retrain_control.note: Same recipe, two independent training runs, same 25 pages.  A difference here is training noise and nothing else.

seed_inclusive.provenance: recomputed here from the same-recipe retrain pairs in retrain_control; cross-checks the project note of ~3.5 from 9 recipes trained twice

easy_hard_split.definition: the 9 pages with the lowest R3 pct@0.5s; circular for R3 itself

coda.claim: CODA (ISMIR 2026) 88.3 vs cyolo_sb 79.9 on room, +8.4 points
coda.reason: CODA per-piece scores are not released and we have no CODA checkpoint, so no paired test is possible.  Only the two pooled numbers exist.

unpaired_bound.interpretation: Treating the two published numbers as independent draws over pieces -- the only inference available without CODA per-piece scores -- the gap is NOT resolvable.

paired_counterfactual.note: If CODA per-piece scores behaved like the cyolo_sb -> cyolo_sb_a pair (the closest available analogue: same benchmark, same family, similar gap), a +8.4 paired difference WOULD clear alpha=0.05.  We state this as a counterfactual, not a result: it cannot be checked.
